pin_reason: The new full review edition uses the final stateless revision. Client, server, metadata, cache fields, source identifiers and captured messages were migrated together. Historical captures retain their original pin.

sources.supports: Per-request version and capabilities, no initialize handshake; server/discover is mandatory; unsupported version uses -32022.
Required _meta protocolVersion/clientCapabilities; optional clientInfo; resultType in results.
Newline JSON-RPC on stdin/stdout; diagnostics on stderr; optional discovery probe and EOF shutdown.
Unknown tool is protocol error; tool input validation/business errors use isError in a result; annotations are not enforcement.
DiscoverResult and ListToolsResult include resultType, ttlMs and cacheScope; RequestMetaObject defines request fields.
Final revision changes; initialization removal, per-request metadata, discovery, cache fields.
Changing mode requires owner identity or CAP_FOWNER; an ordinary owner can restore its own mode bits.
Capability sets and privileged DAC/identity operations.
no_new_privs prevents execve from conferring additional privileges and is inherited.

quote_policy: Paraphrase and pointers; no extended quotations.
